name: Pilsting (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with a white head bearing the municipal arms of Pilsting (a green frog on white) above vertical stripes of green, white and green.
history: Municipal flag of Pilsting; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Pilsting arms — green frog on white
